This function specifies a first-level GLM model in FSL based on a build_design_matrix bdm object.

Source: R/fsl_l1_model.R
fsl_l1_model.Rd

This function specifies a first-level GLM model in FSL based on a build_design_matrix bdm object.

Usage

fsl_l1_model(
  id = NULL,
  session = NULL,
  l1_confound_files = NULL,
  d_obj,
  gpa,
  model_name = NULL,
  run_nifti = NULL,
  nvoxels = NULL,
  execute_feat = FALSE
)

Arguments

id

subject id.

session

session number.

l1_confound_files

optional first-level confound files.

d_obj

a single-subject design matrix object generated by build_design_matrix

gpa

a gpa (glm_pipeline_arguments) object generated by setup_glm_pipeline

model_name

a string indicating the model name within gpa to setup. If you wish to setup multiple models, this is handled upstream in setup_l1_models.R

run_nifti

an optional character vector of NIfTI filenames used in l1 analysis. Prefer to pass these via the build_design_matrix object in $run_nifti

nvoxels

approximate number of voxels per run.

execute_feat

whether to execute FEAT after writing files.
